skills.name: Store Power
lines: Replaces the basic attack when the user has less than 3 World Tree Power stacks
* Stack 1 World Tree Power
** World Tree Power: +25 PWR per stack, max stack 3
* Activate Storing Power State on user
* Counterattack: Activate Store Power - Counter on user
** Both statuses (Storing Power State and Store Power - Counter) end after pain / poison damage. Hence, they cannot deal with enemies' End-of-Turn attack.
* This skill is overwritten if user is wearing an equipment that replaces basic attack skill slot

skills.name: Monde Enlisant
lines: Water type slash attack on all enemies (XL)
* Consume one World Tree Power stack to increase skill damage by 3 times (480% multiplier)
* If not in Another Force and user took no damage in this turn, further increase skill damage by 10 times
** No damage period is until delayed actions, any damage after that is not counted
** 0 damage and MP burn are not counted
** Damage from allies (include self damage) are counted.
